curlMultilineDescription: Display the cURL command in multiple lines.
curlLongFormOptionsDescription: Use the long form in the cURL command, e.g., --request instead of -X.
curlLineContinuationCharDescription: Set the line continuation character for multiline cURL, typically \ on Linux and Mac, ^ on Windows CMD, and ` on PowerShell.
curlSingleQuoteDescription: Use single quotes in the cURL command. Some terminals may not support single quotes (e.g., Windows CMD), so you can disable this option.
curlExtractEnvVariableDescription: Whether environment variables should be replaced with their values.
